description: Two function generators that overshoot their target by a random amount, with minimum, maximum and comparator outputs taken across the pair.

params.text: Picks the timing range for that channel: the shortest rise or fall becomes 1ms, 10ms or 100ms, and the sliders stretch it to about a thousand times that.
Bends the slope of that channel from logarithmic through linear to exponential.
Starts a rise to 10V on that channel, which falls back once it arrives.
Sets the rise time of that channel, from the shortest time the range switch allows to about a thousand times longer.
Sets the fall time of that channel, from the shortest time the range switch allows to about a thousand times longer.
Puts that channel into looping, retriggering itself at the end of each fall.
Attenuates one channel before the MIN, MAX and B>A outputs: at one end of its travel channel B is scaled to nothing, at the other channel A, and centred both pass at full.
Sets how far that channel overshoots a change at its input, from nothing to the size of the change again, with a fresh random amount each time.

inputs.text: The voltage that channel slews towards.
A trigger here starts a rise to 10V on that channel.
Lengthens the rise of that channel by a tenth of the slider range per volt.
Lengthens the fall of that channel by a tenth of the slider range per volt.
Shortens both the rise and the fall of that channel by a tenth of the slider range per volt, and lengthens them on negative voltage.
4V or more here puts that channel into looping, retriggering at the end of each fall.
Adds to the overshoot amount of that channel, 10V covering the whole range.

outputs.text: 10V while that channel is rising, 0V otherwise.
10V while that channel is falling, 0V otherwise.
A 1ms 10V pulse when that channel finishes its fall.
The slewed voltage of that channel.
10V while channel B is above channel A once BALANCE has been applied, 0V otherwise.
The lower of the two channel voltages, once BALANCE has been applied.
The higher of the two channel voltages, once BALANCE has been applied.

inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.10: high above 4V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.11: high above 4V · stepped · one channel only
